body.h: This pattern is based on the mixed count feed. At the start the jugglers stand in a square. Anne faces Ben, and Clare faces Daniel. Anne and Clare walk around each other on one circle. Ben and Daniel walk around each other on another circle. When you are in the square formation you pass with the person in front of you. When you are in the line formation: if you are in the middle of the line, you pass with the person in front of you; if you are at the end of the line, you don't pass.
